Subject: PrivateNet pilot — request for subsidy & security checklist

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We kicked off an internal risk review and procurement has asked for a bit more structure before we sign the PO. Two asks from our side: 1) an extra 30 days of credits on the PrivateNet pilot so we can complete a short penetration test and 2) a checklist of the security artifacts Redwood can provide (SOC2 scope, network diagrams, audit log export, sample configuration for isolated nodes).

Can you confirm what you can provide and whether the credit extension is possible on a conditional basis (we'll share the pen-test scope and a PO acceptance date once procurement approves). We're available for a 30-minute call this week if that's easier.

Attachments: PN_security_request_form.xlsx (spreadsheet with procurement fields)

Best,
Sara Jenkins
Head of Platform Integrations
MedSync Health

Hi Sara — thanks, and totally understand the ask. We can offer a conditional 45-day credit top-up to cover the pen-test window provided the following evidence is delivered within the extension period:

- Signed NDA or PO acceptance (procurement)
- Pen-test scope and expected remediation timeline
- Evidence artifacts: audit log export sample, network topology diagram for the PrivateNet environment, list of enabled encryption/KMS configs, and account-level RBAC settings export

I'm attaching our standard conditional credit template that spells the conditions and the sign-off flow (redwood_conditional_template.pdf). Marissa — looping you in for approvals and any constraints from Billing. Dev — can you confirm what artifacts we can produce from the PrivateNet trial and an estimate on the time to pull a sample audit log and topology?

If it's helpful I can schedule a 30-minute sync with MedSync security + our infra team — propose Wed 30 Jul 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez

On Tue, Jul 29, 2025 at 9:04 AM Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodai.com> wrote:
> I'm attaching our standard conditional credit template that spells the conditions and the sign-off flow

Hi all — quick note from infra: we can export an audit log sample (JSON lines) and a topology diagram (drawn from the deployment manifest) within 48 hours of request. For the KMS details we can provide a statement of config and the key metadata (no private key material). For RBAC we can export the role bindings for the trial tenant.

I should note one limitation: pen-test customers need to coordinate with our on-call infra window for any destructive tests. We can provide a short maintenance window and have an engineer on the call. If MedSync wants to run an external pentest that involves active exploitation, we'll require a signed scoping agreement and a start date so we can isolate traffic and capture telemetry.

I'll prepare the artifacts and upload to the shared drive link once Alex confirms the needed formats.

—Dev
